proposal_topic: M3 null-boundary decision-rule redesign (GATE-030/GATE-035 at the null cell) -- select among explicit H0/H1 comparison, spike-and-slab, hurdle model, or preregistered ROPE threshold
scientific_basis: Current transform n=expit(logit_n) confirmed from source (m3_bayesian_discrete.py::_from_unconstrained): for every finite logit_n, 0<n<1, so n=0 is structurally absent from parameter support. Decision rule (lo>0.0 on posterior 95% CI) is therefore true by construction at the n_true=0 cell, independent of data -- directly explains the observed 200/200 (100%) false-positive rate as a mechanical consequence, not a substantive model-failure finding.
limitations: Preferred future direction: M3-NULL-A explicit two-model comparison (H0:n=0 vs H1:0<n<1), sharing all non-excitation components (baseline, exposure, observation model, overdispersion, covariates, temporal aggregation, source-observation assumptions). Acceptable alternative: M3-NULL-B hurdle/latent-indicator. Conditionally acceptable: M3-NULL-C spike-and-slab (requires documented prior + sensitivity analysis). Rejected as exact-null fix: epsilon clipping, near-zero-as-zero, logit(n)-alone-with-near-zero-declaration. Baseline nesting required (excitation model at n=0 must equal null model) or NULL_AND_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_NESTED must be recorded. No prior values selected -- requires separate versioned implementation review. Must operate under the same observation regime as the historical application (year-level aggregation, ties, source-observation, parent-child, missing/duplicate scenarios), not only idealized continuous timestamps. Decision-rule/threshold selection (model-selection statistic, posterior probability threshold, Bayes factor, ROPE) explicitly deferred to Proposal 5, not decided here. M0 excluded (NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_MODEL_DOMAIN, no excitation parameter). M2 exact-null representability is a SEPARATE_DEPENDENCY, not automatically inherited from the M3 solution. Original 100% false-positive result remains historically visible with an attached non-substantive-failure interpretation; original gate spec, M3 source, and raw outputs unchanged; future implementation requires NEW versioned files (e.g. MODEL_3B_M3_EXACT_NULL_SPECIFICATION_V2, MODEL_3B_RECOVERY_GATE_SPECIFICATION_V2), not created this turn.

proposal_topic: M3 branching-ratio bias at non-null cells (GATE-033/034, ~20% relative bias) -- no amendment proposed, recommend full-scale rerun after null-boundary fix
scientific_basis: Current invalid rule (lower interval bound > 0.0) forces excitation-positive at the exact-null cell since n=expit(logit_n) is always in (0,1) (Proposal 4). Observed 200/200 null-cell false positives confirmed as a mechanical consequence, not evidence against a calibrated rule. FPR_hat(tau)=(1/R0)*sum I[P(M1|Y_r)>=tau] and FNR_hat(tau)=(1/R1)*sum I[P(M1|Y_r)<tau] must be evaluated jointly -- an extreme threshold that satisfies FPR<=0.05 by eliminating all positive-signal detection power is explicitly rejected by the required selection procedure.
limitations: Primary decision quantity P(M1|Y); threshold tau NOT set this turn, requires prospective synthetic calibration on a SEPARATE seed set from final evaluation (calibration/evaluation seed-set separation mandatory, tau must not be calibrated and evaluated on the same replications). tau=0.95 not assumed universal; candidate grid (0.50/0.75/0.90/0.95/0.975/0.99) is prospective only. Threshold must satisfy FPR<=0.05 across all mandatory null scenarios AND retain meaningful FNR/power against a positive-n grid -- FPR alone is insufficient. MCSE required for both FPR_hat and FNR_hat; near-0.05 results must not be classified confidently without it. Prior model odds not selected -- equal odds (0.5/0.5) is one evaluable candidate only, requires separate versioned justification. Bayes factor approved as SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC only, not primary rule; no universal BF categories (>3/>10/>100) assumed without calibration. ROPE is supplementary magnitude interpretation only, does not replace the exact-null-vs-excitation model comparison; epsilon_n not selected, must not be derived from the historical fit. INCONCLUSIVE outcome is mandatory -- no dataset may be forced into excitation or no-excitation. Decision rule must be tested against baseline/CD/overdispersion/source-concentration/episode-dependence/missing/duplicate confounds, must not label temporal clustering as excitation from these mechanisms. Must reproduce the Atlas observation regime, not only idealized continuous timestamps. M0 NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_MODEL_DOMAIN; M2 SEPARATE_EXACT_NULL_AND_DECISION_RULE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, not automatically inherited. Depends on Proposal 4 (does not replace or modify it).
